# BIG SQUARE PUZZLE - Tony Horncastle - DREAMER 14 p.15 (PDF page 17) - CHIP-8 0200-03F1, run C000
# Sliding-block puzzle: move the big square (block 2) out of the 'gate' (dotted line on the
# right) in as few moves as possible. Key the block number, then the direction:
# 5 = Up (035D), 8 = Left (0365), A = Right (0359), D = Down (0361). The article prints
# "5 - Down": a typo, the code at 03A0 moves the block up (Y - 8). Any key other than 5/8/A
# after the block number also moves it down (0362 3A08 13C4, as printed).
# Invalid moves are refused and must be re-entered.
# Move counter shown at the bottom right.
